Kamyabi ke liye kya zaroori hai? : Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain "Duha se murad roshni hai", Qatada (R.H) farmate hain "poora din murad hai". Imam Jarir (R.H) farmate hain ke theek baat yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne sooraj ki aur din ki qasam khayi hai aur chand jabke uske peeche aaye yani sooraj chup jaye aur chand chamakne lage. Ibn Zaid (R.H) farmate hain ke mahine ke pehle pandrah din mein toh chand sooraj ke peeche rehta hai aur pichle pandrah dinon mein aage hota hai, Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) farmate hain murad is se Lailatul Qadr hai.

Phir din ki qasam khayi jabke woh munawwar hojaye yani suraj din ko gher le, ba'az Arabi danon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke din jabke andhere ko roshan kar de lekin agar yun kaha jata ke phailawat ko woh jab chamka de to aur achha hota hai taake yaghshaha mein bhi yeh ma'ani theek baithte, isi liye Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain din ki qasam jabke woh ise roshan kar de, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir is qaul ko pasand farmate hain ke in sab mein zameer 'ha' ka marja' shams hai kyunke isi ka zikr chal raha hai, raat jabke ise dhanp le yani suraj ko dhanp le aur charon taraf andhera phail jaye, Yazid bin Zi-Himaya kehte hain ke jab raat aati hai to Allah Ta'ala Jalla Jalaluhu farmata hai mere bandon ko meri ek bahut badi khalq ne chupaliya pas makhlooq raat se haibat karti hai halanke iske paida karne wale se zyada haibat karni chahiye, (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) phir aasman ki qasam khata hai yahan jo 'ma' hai yeh masdariya bhi hosakta hai, yani aasman aur uski banawat ki qasam, Hazrat Qatada ka qaul yahi hai aur yeh 'ma' ma'ani mein 'man' ke bhi hosakta hai to matlab yeh hoga ke aasman ki qasam aur uske banane wale ki qasam, yani khud Allah ki, Mujahid yahi farmate hain yeh dono ma'ani ek dusre ko lazim-o-malzoom hain bana ke ma'ani bulandi ke hain jaise aur jagah hai 'Wassama-e-banainaha bi-aydin' al-kh, yani aasman ko humne quwwat ke sath banaya aur hum kushadgi wale hain humne zameen ko bichhaya aur kya hi achha hum bichhane wale hain, is tarah yahan bhi farmaya ke zameen ki aur uski hamwari ki, use bichhane, phailane ki, uski taqseem ki, uski makhlooq ki qasam, zyada mashhoor qaul iski tafseer mein phailane ka hai, ahl-e-lughat ke nazdeek bhi yahi ma'roof hai, Jauhari farmate hain 'taha' 'taha' misl 'wahala' ke hai aur iske ma'ani phailane ke hain aksar mufassireen ka yahi qaul hai phir farmaya nafs ki aur use theek-thaak banane ki qasam yani use paida kiya aur aan-hal-aake yeh theek-thaak aur fitrat par qaim tha jaise aur jagah hai 'Fa-aqim wajhaka' al-kh, apne chehre ko qaim rakh deen-e-hanif ke liye fitrat hai, Allah ki jis par logon ko banaya Allah ki khalq ki tabdeel nahin, hadith mein hai har bacha fitrat par paida hota hai phir uske maa-baap use Yahudi ya Nasrani ya Majusi bana lete hain jaise chaupaye janwar ka bacha sahih salim paida hota hai koi in mein kan-kata na paoge (Bukhari-o-Muslim) Sahih Muslim Sharif ki ek hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai maine apne bande ko yaksooi wale paida kiye unke paas shaitan pahuncha aur deen se warghala liya, phir farmata hai ke Allah ne uske liye badkari-o-parhezgari ko bayan kardiya aur jo cheez uski qismat mein thi uski taraf uski rahbari hui, Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain yani khair-o-sharr zahir kardiya, Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Hazrat Abu-al-Aswad farmate hain ke Hazrat Imran bin Husain (R.A) ne poocha zara batao to log jo kuch a'maal karte hain aur takleefein utha rahe hain yeh kya unke liye Allah ki janib se muqarrar ho chuki hain aur unki taqdeer mein likhi ja chuki hain ya yeh khud aainda ke liye apne taur par kar rahe hain is bina par ke ambiya ke paas aa chuke aur Allah ki hujjat un par poori hui, main jawab mein kaha nahin nahin balki yeh cheez pehle se faisal-shuda hai aur muqaddar ho chuki hai, Hazrat Imran ne kaha phir yeh zulm to na hoga, main to ise sun kar kanp utha aur ghabra kar kaha ke har cheez ka khaliq-o-malik wahi Allah hai tamam mulk usi ke hath mein hai uske af'aal ki baaz-purs koi nahin kar sakta woh sab se sawal kar sakta hai, mera yeh jawab sun kar Hazrat Imran bahut khush hue aur kaha Allah tujhe durustagi inayat farmaye main ne to yeh sawalat isi liye kiye the ke imtehan hojaye, suno ek shakhs Muzaina-o-Juhaina qabile ka An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur yahi sawal kiya jo main ne pehle tum se kiya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhi wahi jawab diya jo tum ne diya to usne kaha phir hamare a'maal se kya? Aap ne jawaban irshad farmaya ke jis kisi ko Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne jis manzil ke liye paida kiya hai us se waise hi kaam ho kar rahenge agar jannati hai to a'maal-e-jannat aur dozakhi likha gaya hai to waise hi a'maal us par aasaan honge suno Quran mein iski tasdeeq majood hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai 'Wanafsin wama sawwaha, fa-alhamaha fujuraha wa taqwaha' yeh hadith Muslim Sharif mein bhi hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai ke jisne apne nafs ko paak kiya aur ba-murad hua, yani ita'at-e-Rabb mein laga raha, nakamme a'maal-o-razil akhlaq chhod diye jaise aur jagah hai 'Qad aflaha man tazakka, wa zakarasma Rabbihi fasalla' jisne pakeezgi ikhtiyar ki aur apne Rabb ka naam yaad kiya phir namaz padhi usne kamyabi pali aur jisne apne zameer ka satiyanas kiya aur hidayat se hata kar use barbad kiya, nafarmaniyon mein pad gaya ita'at-e-Allah ko chhod baitha yeh nakam aur na-murad hua.

Aur yeh ma'ani bhi ho sakte hain ke jis ke nafs ko Allah Ta'ala ne paak kiya aur ba-murad hua aur jis ke nafs ko Allah ne neeche gira diya woh barbad, khaib aur khasir raha, Aufi aur Ali bin Abu Talha Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yahi riwayat karte hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat "Qad aflaha man zakkaha" parh kar farmaya ke jis nafs ko Allah ne paak kiya us ne chhutkara pa liya, lekin is hadith mein ek illat toh yeh hai ke Juwaibir bin Saeed matrook-ul-hadith hai, dusri illat yeh hai ke Zahhak jo Hazrat Abdullah se riwayat karte hain un ki mulaqat sabit nahin. Tabrani ki hadith mein hai ke "Fal-hamaha fujuraha wa taqwaha" parh kar aap ne yeh dua parhi: "Allahumma aati nafsi taqwaha, anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha, wa anta khairu man zakkaha." Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki hadith mein yeh dua yun warid hui hai: "Allahumma aati nafsi taqwaha wa zakkaha, anta khairu man zakkaha, anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha." Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Hazrat Ayesha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) farmati hain ke raat ko ek martaba meri aankh khuli, main ne dekha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne bistar par nahin, andhere ki wajah se main ghar mein apne hathon se tatolne lagi toh mere hath aap par pare, aap us waqt sajde mein the aur yeh dua parh rahe the: "Rabbi aati nafsi taqwaha wa zakkaha, anta khairu man zakkaha, anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha." Yeh hadith sirf Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hi hai. Muslim Sharif aur Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh dua maangte the: "Allahumma inni a'uzu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-harami wal-jubni wal-bukhli wa 'azabil-qabr. Allahumma aati nafsi taqwaha wa zakkaha, anta khairu man zakkaha, anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha. Allahumma inni a'uzu bika min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa 'ilmin la yanfa', wa da'watin la yustajabu laha." Ya Allah! Main aajizi, be-chargi, susti, thakawat, burhape, namardi se aur bakhili aur azab-e-qabr se teri panah chahta hoon. Aye Allah! Mere dil ko is ka taqwa ata farma aur ise paak kar de, tu hi ise behtar paak karne wala hai, tu hi is ka wali aur mawla hai. Aye Allah! Mujhe aise dil se bacha jis mein tera dar na ho aur aise nafs se bacha jo aasuda na ho aur aise ilm se bacha jo nafa na de aur aisi dua se bacha jo qabool na ki jaye. Rawi-e-hadith mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam farmate hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamein yeh dua sikhayi aur hum tumhein sikhate hain.

Muslim Sharif aur Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh dua maangte the: "Allahumma inni a'uzu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-harami wal-jubni wal-bukhli wa 'azabil-qabr. Allahumma aati nafsi taqwaha wa zakkaha, anta khairu man zakkaha, anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha. Allahumma inni a'uzu bika min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa 'ilmin la yanfa', wa da'watin la yustajabu laha." Ya Allah! Main aajizi, be-chargi, susti, thakawat, burhape, namardi se aur bakhili aur azab-e-qabr se teri panah chahta hoon. Aye Allah! Mere dil ko is ka taqwa ata farma aur ise paak kar de, tu hi ise behtar paak karne wala hai, tu hi is ka wali aur mawla hai. Aye Allah! Mujhe aise dil se bacha jis mein tera dar na ho aur aise nafs se bacha jo aasuda na ho aur aise ilm se bacha jo nafa na de aur aisi dua se bacha jo qabool na ki jaye. Rawi-e-hadith mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam farmate hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamein yeh dua sikhayi aur hum tumhein sikhate hain.

Aal-e-Thamud ki tabahi ke asbab: Allah Ta'ala bayan farma raha hai ke Thamudiyon ne apni sarkashi, takabbur-o-tajabbur ki bina par apne Rasool ki tasdeeq na ki. Muhammad bin Ka'ab farmate hain 'bi-taghwaha' ka matlab yeh hai ke un sab ne takzeeb ki lekin pehli baat hi zyada aula hai, Hazrat Mujahid aur Hazrat Qatada ne bhi yahi bayan kiya hai, is sarkashi aur takzeeb ki shamat se yeh is qadar badbakht ho gayi ke un mein se jo zyada bad-shakhs tha woh tayyar ho gaya, us ka naam Qudar bin Salif tha, isi ne Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni ki kochein kaati thin, isi ke bare mein farman hai 'fanadau sahibahum fata'ata fa'aqar'. Thamudiyon ki aawaz par yeh aa gaya aur us ne oontni ko maar dala, yeh shakhs is qaum mein zi-izzat tha, shareef tha, zi-nasab tha, qaum ka raees aur sardar tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne ek martaba apne khutbe mein is oontni ka aur us ke maar dalne wale ka zikr kiya, is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya ke jaise Abu Zam'a tha isi jaisa yeh shakhs bhi apni qaum mein shareef, azeez aur bada aadmi tha. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne ise tafsir mein aur Imam Muslim (R.H) ne jahannam ki sifat mein laye hain aur Sunan-e-Tirmidhi, Sunan-e-Nasa'i mein bhi yeh riwayat tafsir mein hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya ke main tujhe duniya bhar ke badbakht tareen do shakhs batata hoon, ek toh Aheim-e-Thamud jis ne oontni ko maar dala aur dusra woh shakhs jo teri peshani par zakhm lagaye ga yahan tak ke daadhi khoon se tar-ba-tar ho jaye gi. Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne apni qaum se farmaya tha ke ae qaum! Allah ki oontni ko burai pahunchane se daro, us ke pani peene ke muqarrar din mein zulm karke use pani se na roko, tumhari aur us ki baari muqarrar hai. Lekin in badbakhton ne paighambar ki na maani, jis gunah ke baais un ke dil sakht ho gaye aur phir yeh saaf taur par muqable ke liye tayyar ho gaye aur us oontni ki kochein kaat dein, jise Allah Ta'ala ne baghair maa-baap ke patthar ki ek chattan se paida kiya tha jo Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ka mojiza aur Allah ki qudrat ki kaamil nishani thi. Allah bhi un par ghazabnaak ho gaya aur halakat daal di. Aur sab par abr se azab utra, yeh is liye ke Aheim-e-Thamud ke haath par us ki qaum ke chhote badon ne, mard auraton ne bai'at kar li thi aur sab ke mashware se us ne is oontni ko kaata tha, is liye azab mein bhi sab pakde gaye. 'Wala yakhafu' ko 'fala yakhafu' bhi padha gaya hai. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah kisi ko saza kare toh use yeh khauf nahin hota ke us ka anjam kya hoga? Kahin yeh bigad na baithein. Yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke is badkar, Aheim ne oontni ko maar toh dala lekin anjam se na dara, magar pehla qaul hi aula hai. Wallahu A'alam. Alhamdulillah, Surah Ash-Shams ki tafsir khatam hui.
